.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (byte comparison of test.sh, Dockerfiles, tools, scoring.toml, task.toml)
evidence: Checks run read-only against the frozen task (.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/task). TOML: Python tomllib loads task.toml, tests/scoring.toml and all five judge.toml files (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) with no error; criterion counts 1/2/40/6/3, zero duplicate ids per file; each [judge].prompt_template = 'prompt.md' resolves to an existing file containing '{criteria}'. Shell: 'bash -n' exits 0 for tests/test.sh and solution/solve.sh; both start with '#!/bin/bash' (test.sh:1, solve.sh:1). The embedded Python heredocs in test.sh (probe_ready at test.sh:44-58, the prompt-context injection at test.sh:195-201) parse with ast. Line endings: a byte scan of all 43 task files found no CR byte, no UTF-8 BOM, no non-UTF-8 file and no file lacking a final newline. JSON: environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/package.json, package-lock.json and tsconfig.json all load. Python: tests/tools/score.py and tests/tools/restart_mcp.py parse with ast. Reference entry: 'node --check' passes for solution/app/server.js, solution/app/public/assets/index.js and vite.config.mjs; src/custom-editor.js passes as an ES module (it is Vite source, not a runtime file; the CommonJS-mode check error is expected because package.json sets type=commonjs). server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5), which both images install globally and expose through NODE_PATH (environment/Dockerfile:3,9-12; tests/Dockerfile:9,17-22; test.sh:106). It resolves files from __dirname (server.js:7,130-131), honours DB_PATH (server.js:8), listens on 0.0.0.0:PORT||3000 (server.js:142) and answers /api/health (server.js:12), matching test.sh:68,97-111 and integration.md:3,9. public/index.html references /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, both shipped prebuilt, so no install or build step is needed. solve.sh copies solution/app to /app (solve.sh last line) and checks server.js exists. test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tools/*.py, .dockerignore, environment/Dockerfile and scoring.toml are byte-identical to the frozen template; task.toml differs only in the CHANGE_ME identity/metadata fields. Budgets nest: gates 1500 + scored 11100 = 12600 <= verifier 13200 (test.sh:212,222; task.toml [verifier]). Raw evidence index: all 15 cited artifact SHA256 values re-computed and match (0 mismatches); it records that the golden server actually started and survived one real process restart in a scripted run on these task bytes. Limits, stated plainly: I did not start the app or any container myself; the scripted run was as root without DB_PATH, so the exact test.sh launch path (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH) and a full configured judge run remain unmeasured. Those belong to the runtime-evidence rows and do not change this well-formedness row; nothing here is an Oracle, model or portal result. Weak-app/alternative probe: a submission with CRLF or a syntax error in its own server.js would simply fail the liveness probe (test.sh:113-123) and score zero on its own merits, and a conforming alternative using other frontend tooling is not penalised by any parse step in the harness.
